description: A host's previous parking advice message somehow lands in the queue as if it were a new guest message. The system must not treat host replies as guest questions and must not escalate them.
guestMessage: Hi - For paid parking, we have 192-234 Vaughan Street Parking nearby. The alternative is to find street parking in the area, usually towards the Western Promenade. I recommend using the SpotHero application, where you can book in advance and get cheaper rates. Hope this helps!

rubric.notes: This is clearly a host reply. The system must detect it is not a guest question and must NOT escalate it. This was a regression from the old system.
